metadata.title: Crystallization of the undertile
metadata.abstract: We classify all periodic tilings with a monotile known as $\mathbf{R1}$ and called here the undertile, which underlies several aperiodic monotiles such as the Taylor-Socolar one. The classification is done using deflation, through a study of fracture lines between zones where deflation can be performed. A full classification of fracture patterns is given, that also applies to non-periodic tilings with the undertile. This can be used to reprove non-periodicity of some existing monotiles based on the undertile.

metadata.title: Resolutions of orbifold generalised triangle groups
metadata.abstract: Let $T=\langle f,g\mid f^{l}=g^{m}=W^{n}=1\rangle$ be a generalised triangle group in which $W$ is the Farey word of a rational slope $q=r/s$, and suppose that $T$ is the fundamental group of a hyperbolic $3$-orbifold whose singular locus has no spherical vertices. Let $G=\langle f,g\mid f^{l}=g^{m}=W^{n}\rangle$ be the associated central extension. We compute an explicit free resolution of the trivial module over $\mathbb{Z}G$ of minimal length, with differentials given in closed form by Fox derivatives. From this resolution we deduce an explicit free resolution over $\mathbb{Z}T$ which is $2$-periodic in degrees at least two, and we compute the integral homology and cohomology of both groups. Strebel treated the classical family $q=0/1$ in 1983. Since then only the family $q=1/2$ has been treated, by Ellis and Williams, and for that family our resolution over $\mathbb{Z}T$ has strictly smaller rank in every degree.

metadata.title: A counterexample to a conjecture of Plotnick on knot exteriors
metadata.abstract: We resolve a conjecture of S. Plotnick from 1983 concerning the homotopy type of four-dimensional knot complements. We show that the exteriors of two branched twist spins of the trefoil, which were shown by Plotnick not to be homotopy equivalent as boundary pairs and hence not homeomorphic, are in fact simple homotopy equivalent. The main ingredient of the proof is the construction of an explicit element of augmentation $49$ in the integral group ring of $\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_5)$ which is a unit modulo the group norm and commutes with the element inducing the monodromy on the fundamental group.

metadata.title: Exotic diffeomorphisms on closed aspherical $4$-manifolds
metadata.abstract: We study a class of diffeomorphisms of closed manifolds obtained from Davis' reflection trick construction, which are obtained by reflecting a diffeomorphism supported in the fundamental chamber of such a manifold. We use this construction to exhibit the first examples of closed aspherical $4$-manifolds with diffeomorphisms that are topologically isotopic to the identity map, but not smoothly isotopic to it.

metadata.title: Quantum Color Newton Rings
metadata.abstract: We study integral Newton rings attached to symmetric quantum colors. We show that their boundary values at a deleted node are exactly the elements of Habiro's cyclotomic completion, and we describe their quantum neighborhoods at $q=1$ uniformly in the rank. The symmetric-color $\mathfrak{sl}_n$ invariants of a knot are the values of an element of such a ring. In its expansion at $q=1$, the coefficient of $(q-1)^m$ has denominator dividing the $(n-1+2m)$th power of the Alexander polynomial, with integral numerator, and this exponent is sharp. For $5_2$ and $6_1$ at $q=i$, the period matrices of the rank-two coefficient recurrences have spectral modules of exact order three in the Picard group of an affine elliptic curve.

metadata.title: Random Quotients of Hyperbolic Spaces with Respect to WPD Actions and Linear Connectivity of the Boundary
metadata.abstract: We study random quotients of acylindrically hyperbolic groups and hierchically hyperbolic groups, whose (partial) hyperbolicity is captured by their actions on Gromov hyperbolic spaces. We show that if an acylindrically hyperbolic group $G$ acts on a Gromov hyperbolic space $X$ coarsely transitively with a WPD element, then the quotient of $X$ by the normal closure of a random element of $G$ has linearly connected boundary. If $G$ is a group with a (relative) hierarchically hyperbolic group structure, with a quasi-tree top domain $X$, then in fact the quotient of $X$ by the normal closure of a random element of $G$ has boundary homeomorphic to the Nöbeling curve.

metadata.title: Holomorphic Triangles in the Heegaard Floer Pillowcase
metadata.abstract: The Heegaard Floer pillowcase is a recurring local model for rational tangle replacement and exact-triangle constructions. We compute the triangle product for its standard rational-slope triples of curves and encode all contributing classes in a finite generating polynomial. One slope ordering gives a vanishing map. For the other, a closed form for the generating function is computed. One may assume that the slopes are $\tfrac10,\tfrac pq$ and $\tfrac{p'}{q'}$. When an integer lies between the two finite slopes, the closed form has a particularly simple description and there are exactly $2(pq'-p'q)+2qq'$ contributing classes. We also compute the absolute Maslov bi-gradings of the intersection generators in the employed model, relating the planar labels to the graded Floer groups of two-bridge knots and links.

metadata.title: The Rate of the Delsarte Bound for Binary Codes and Spheres
metadata.abstract: We give the asymptotic rate of Delsarte's linear programming bound for binary codes and spherical codes. This extends previous work of the author which formulated and proved an analogue of the conjecture of Afkhami-Jeddi, Cohn, Hartman, de Laat, and Tajdini for binary codes, obtaining the rate of the Delsarte linear program at distance $1/2-1/\pi$. The lower bounds introduce ideas from potential theory into the study of Delsarte's bounds, whereby the measures underlying a system of orthogonal polynomials give an obstacle problem. We solve the resulting obstacle problem in the case of binary codes and spherical codes, obtaining a closed form for the lower bound in terms of elliptic integrals. For the upper bounds, we relate the $N$-qubit construction for binary codes used in previous work of the author to the constructions in OpenAI's Chapter 2 for spherical codes and observe that they both involve interlacing spectra. This leads to a variational problem involving measures constructed from these spectra under the Markov-Krein correspondence. This variational problem admits an exact solution and matches the lower bound.

analysisBasis.abstract: We give the asymptotic rate of Delsarte's linear programming bound for binary codes and spherical codes. This extends previous work of the author which formulated and proved an analogue of the conjecture of Afkhami-Jeddi, Cohn, Hartman, de Laat, and Tajdini for binary codes, obtaining the rate of the Delsarte linear program at distance $1/2-1/\pi$. The lower bounds introduce ideas from potential theory into the study of Delsarte's bounds, whereby the measures underlying a system of orthogonal polynomials give an obstacle problem. We solve the resulting obstacle problem in the case of binary codes and spherical codes, obtaining a closed form for the lower bound in terms of elliptic integrals. For the upper bounds, we relate the $N$-qubit construction for binary codes used in previous work of the author to the constructions in OpenAI's Chapter 2 for spherical codes and observe that they both involve interlacing spectra. This leads to a variational problem involving measures constructed from these spectra under the Markov-Krein correspondence. This variational problem admits an exact solution and matches the lower bound.

metadata.title: Napoleonic triangles on the sphere from similar chord triangles
metadata.abstract: We study a variant of Napoleon's construction on the unit sphere, in which the triangles erected on the sides of a spherical triangle $ABC$ are required to have similar isosceles chord triangles with apex angle $\beta\in(0,\pi/2)$. For a non-equilateral $ABC$, we prove that the triangle $XYZ$ of spherical circumcentres is equilateral if and only if $\cos(\theta_a+\theta_b+\theta_c\pm\Omega/2)=0$, where $\theta_a,\theta_b,\theta_c$ are the base angles of the isosceles spherical triangles $XBC$, $YCA$, $ZAB$, $\Omega$ is the area of $ABC$, and the sign $+$ (resp.~$-$) corresponds to the outward (resp.~inward) construction. We derive from this an explicit classification in terms of two quadrics and a cubic inequality. It recovers the theorem of Dipierro, Noakes and Valdinoci for $\beta=\pi/3$, and exhibits three families of solutions for $\beta>\pi/3$, together with a fourth one when $\cos\beta<1/4$.

metadata.title: On the Solution Sets of the Cone-Volume Map
metadata.abstract: For a fixed set $U=(u_1,\ldots,u_m)$ of outer unit normals, we consider the cone-volume map which associates to a vector of support numbers $b\in\mathbb R^m_{> 0}$ the cone-volume vector $\gamma\in\mathbb R^m$ of the polytope \[ P(U,b)=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n:U^\top x\leq b\}. \] We study its fibers $S(U,\gamma)$ over prescribed cone-volume vectors $\gamma$, with particular emphasis on finiteness and non-uniqueness. We give characterizations of the irreducibility of $U$ in terms of properties of the cone-volume map and its solution sets. In particular, for irreducible $U$, we show that $S(U,\gamma)$ is finite for all $\gamma$ outside a set of measure zero in the cone-volume cone, and we give an explicit upper bound for its cardinality. In the planar case, we prove that $S(U,\gamma)$ has semialgebraic dimension at most one for arbitrary $U$. Moreover, for every $U\in\mathcal{U}(2,m)$ with $m\geq 4$, there exists a cone-volume vector $\gamma$ for which $S(U,\gamma)$ contains at least two distinct elements. As a consequence, there exist two distinct smooth planar convex bodies with the same cone-volume measure. Finally, for $U$ in general position, we show that the number of solutions is odd for every cone-volume vector outside the exceptional set.

metadata.title: Lattice coverings by parallelotopes containing cube vertices
metadata.abstract: We investigate when a parallelotope containing vertices of the unit cube $Q_n=[0,1]^n$ covers $\Bbb R^n$ by integer translates. We prove the covering property for every parallelepiped containing five vertices of $Q_3$, and, in any dimension, for every parallelotope containing a facet of $Q_n$ and one vertex of the opposite facet. As a consequence, we obtain the sharp bound $1/n$ for the volume of a pyramid contained in $Q_n$ with a parallelotope base. We also give an alternative proof of this bound.

metadata.title: Augmentation curve for torus knots
metadata.abstract: We prove a version of topological recursion for the correlation differentials of colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials of torus knots on the corresponding augmentation curves, following the proposal of Gu, Jockers, Klemm, and Soroush. To this end, we explicitly construct the spectral curve from the so-called auxiliary curve of Brini, Eynard, and Mariño and prove that it coincides with the augmentation curve for every torus knot with coprime $(r,s)$. Finally, our version of topological recursion proves the higher-genus closed-string prediction of the Aganagic--Vafa conjecture for all torus knot augmentation curves.

metadata.title: Visible parts and projections of the affine fractal percolation
metadata.abstract: We study the visible parts and orthogonal projections of the affine fractal percolation. We show that for the affine fractal percolation $E$, conditioned on $E \neq \varnothing$, almost surely the dimension of the visible part is equal to $\min\{1, \dim_{\rm H} E\}$ from all directions except for the major contracting direction. The visible part from the major contracting direction is notably different from the other directions, and we provide a formula for its Hausdorff and box dimensions. In addition, we show that almost surely conditioned on $E \neq \varnothing$, $\dim_{\rm H} \pi(E) =\min\{ 1, \dim_{\rm H} E\}$ for every orthogonal projection $\pi$ excluding the one onto the major contracting direction, and given $\dim_{\rm H} E >1$, these projections contain intervals.

metadata.title: Causal Sobolev spaces and gradient flows
metadata.abstract: We develop a relaxation-based approach to Sobolev functions and Cheeger energies on metric spacetimes, in analogy with the construction used in positive signature. For an exponent $p<0$, we introduce a pre-$p$-Cheeger energy built from a local steepness constant on causal functions, and define the $p$-Cheeger energy as its relaxation in $L^0$; this yields, by construction, a convex and lower semicontinuous functional together with an associated maximal relaxed subslope. We establish natural calculus rules for the resulting Sobolev class. We then define the $p$-heat flow as the gradient flow of the $p$-Cheeger energy in $L^2$ and its generator, the $p$-d'Alembertian. Combining a Kuwada-type lemma with entropy growth estimates along the flow, we show that our notion of Sobolev class and relaxed subslope coincides with the Sobolev class and weak subslope introduced by Beran et al.

metadata.title: Scalar curvature, volume, and Weil-Petersson translation length
metadata.abstract: We construct metrics on pseudoAnosov mapping tori that make every fiber an intrinsically hyperbolic stable minimal surface, and which have scalar curvature identically -6. Using this, we give a new proof (with improved constant) of an inequality bounding the hyperbolic volume of a pseudoAnosov mapping torus by the Weil-Petersson translation length (and consequently, the entropy) of its monodromy.

analysis.workSummary: 在伪 Anosov 映射环上构造标量曲率恒为 −6 的度量，使每个纤维既有内蕴双曲度量又是稳定极小曲面。利用该构造，以改进常数重新证明双曲体积受单值映射 Weil–Petersson 平移长度控制的不等式，并进而获得与熵相关的界。
analysis.breakthrough: 以受控标量曲率和极小纤维结构连接曲面模空间长度与三维体积，并改善常数。
analysis.limitations: 仅依据官方英文摘要解读，尚未核读数学正文。新构造的度量不能直接视为映射环的双曲度量；改进常数的具体数值和熵比较条件未在摘要给出。

analysisBasis.abstract: We construct metrics on pseudoAnosov mapping tori that make every fiber an intrinsically hyperbolic stable minimal surface, and which have scalar curvature identically -6. Using this, we give a new proof (with improved constant) of an inequality bounding the hyperbolic volume of a pseudoAnosov mapping torus by the Weil-Petersson translation length (and consequently, the entropy) of its monodromy.

metadata.title: SL(n)-covariant symmetric tensor valuations on polytopes
metadata.abstract: All $\operatorname{SL}(n)$-covariant symmetric tensor valuations on convex polytopes in $\mathbb R^n$ are completely classified without any continuity assumptions. It is shown that the only such valuation is the moment tensor.

analysis.progressType: 张量赋值的无连续性分类

metadata.title: Extending Donaldson's HyperKähler Structure via Minimal Surfaces into $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{C})$
metadata.abstract: We construct a deformation space for minimal immersions into $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{C})$ with its holomorphic Killing form, and define an explicit, mapping class group invariant, complex hyperKähler structure on such deformation space. Such complex hyperKähler structure restricts to: Donaldson's hyperKähler structure on a totally real copy of almost-Fuchsian space, Mazzoli-Seppi-Tamburelli's para-hyperKähler structure on a totally real copy of maximally globally hyperbolic $\mathbb{A}\mathrm{d}\mathbb{S}^3$ manifolds, and Loustau-Sanders' complex bi-Kähler structure on a holomorphic copy of quasi-Fuchsian space. Moreover, all these loci are totally geodesic. We discuss other geometric aspects of this space, such as the Hamiltonian property of a natural $\mathbb{C}^*$-action, involving the Goldman symplectic form and a complex-valued area functional.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 统一扩张多种超 Kähler 结构
analysis.workSummary: 在带全纯 Killing 形式的 PSL(2,C) 中构造极小浸入的形变空间，并给出显式、映射类群不变的复超 Kähler 结构。其在不同全实或全纯子空间上的限制分别恢复 almost-Fuchsian 的 Donaldson 结构、极大全局双曲 AdS³ 的 para-hyperKähler 结构和 quasi-Fuchsian 的复 bi-Kähler 结构，且这些子空间全测地。还讨论自然 C* 作用与 Goldman 辛形式、复值面积的 Hamilton 性质。
techniques: Goldman 辛形式与 Hamilton 作用
analysis.breakthrough: 把多种看似不同的模空间几何实现为同一复超 Kähler 空间的受控限制。
analysis.limitations: 仅依据官方英文摘要解读，尚未核读数学正文。形变空间的非退化、浸入和局部条件未在摘要中详述；不能推断所有表示空间都具有该结构。

metadata.title: $h$-cobordisms between $1$-connected manifolds with boundary
metadata.abstract: We classify $h$-cobordisms between compact simply-connected $4$-manifolds with boundary in both the smooth and topological categories. This extends a result of Kreck, which proved the corresponding result for closed manifolds. As an application, we recover the injectivity portion of Orson-Powell's computation of the mapping class group for simply-connected topological $4$-manifolds with boundary.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 带边界单连通四维流形的 h 配边分类
analysis.workSummary: 在光滑与拓扑两个范畴中分类紧致单连通四维带边界流形之间的 h 配边，把 Kreck 对闭流形的对应结果推广到带边界情形。作为应用，重新获得 Orson–Powell 关于单连通拓扑四维带边界流形映射类群计算中的单射性部分。
analysis.breakthrough: 将闭流形分类推进到边界存在时的相对问题，并关联已知映射类群结果。
analysis.limitations: 仅依据官方英文摘要解读，尚未核读数学正文。摘要未列出边界标记、相对等价关系及分类数据，不能理解为任意此类 h 配边都平凡。

metadata.title: The rank problem for metric spaces
metadata.abstract: We construct a complete, second countable metric space with uncountable Scott rank. This answers a well-known question posed by Fokina, Friedman, K{ö}rwien and Nies, and shows that the known upper bound $\omega_1$ on the rank, proved by Doucha, is sharp. Further, a Baire category based variant of the rank of metric spaces is developed, and this is used to give new proofs of the known rank bounds based only on standard methods of descriptive set theory.

analysis.progressType: 度量空间 Scott 秩问题的极端构造
analysis.workSummary: 构造一个完备、第二可数且具有不可数 Scott 秩的度量空间，回答 Fokina、Friedman、Körwien 和 Nies 提出的相关问题，表明已知 ω₁ 上界是锐的。另发展基于 Baire 范畴的秩变体，用描述集合论的标准方法重新证明既有秩界。
techniques: 完备可分度量空间构造
analysis.breakthrough: 在完备第二可数的限制下仍实现不可数秩，确定既有上界的锐性。
analysis.limitations: 仅依据官方英文摘要解读，尚未核读数学正文。这里的秩属于结构分类与逻辑复杂度，不能理解为维数或曲率；具体逻辑语言与秩约定待正文核读，清单没有明确版本号。
